pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Individual dark regions exhibit irregular polygonal geometry with sharp pixel-level edge gradients. Spatial area is greatest in the central flank, with patches becoming smaller and more densely clustered as they transition toward the neck.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: The light-colored negative space forms a continuous topological graph with clearly defined tri-valent and tetra-valent junction nodes. Pathway thickness is relatively uniform across the mid-flank, exhibiting consistent pixel width between patch boundaries.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: The mane along the upper neck presents a low-amplitude, high-frequency serrated 1D profile against the background, indicating a short and dense hair structure.
